name: CES 529 TCAS机动 备降/返航

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is CES 529, you are maintaining 8400 meters, make an initial contact with Shanghai Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 CES 529，保持 8400 米，与上海管制首次联系。

cards.audioText: CES 529, Shanghai Control, radar contact, climb to 10,400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 529，上海管制，雷达识别，爬升至 10,400 米。

cards.audioText: now you are cruising at 10,400 meters, your instruments indicate left pack has malfunctioned, contact Shanghai Control and request descend to lower levels.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你正以 10,400 米巡航，仪表显示左组件故障，联系上海管制并请求下降至较低高度。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, CES 529, maintaining 10,400 meters, our instruments indicate the left pack has malfunctioned, request descent to lower levels.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，CES 529，正保持 10,400 米，我们的仪表显示左组件故障，请求下降至较低高度。

cards.audioText: C: CES 529, turn right heading 240, descend to 8900 meters initially.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 529，右转航向 240，先下降至 8900 米。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 240, descend to 8900 meters initially, CES 529.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 240，先下降至 8900 米，CES 529。

cards.audioText: B: During descent, your right pack is overheating, both packs have malfunctioned and request emergency descent, this is a Distress call.
cards.audioTextZh: B：下降中，你的右组件过热，两个组件都故障，请求紧急下降，这是遇险呼叫。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Shanghai Control, CES 529, our right pack is overheating, both packs have malfunctioned, request emergency descent.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，上海管制，CES 529，我们的右组件过热，两个组件都故障，请求紧急下降。

cards.audioText: B: During descent, your cabin altitude is rising rapidly, request emergency descent to 3000 meters, this is a Distress call.
cards.audioTextZh: B：下降中，你的客舱高度快速上升，请求紧急下降至 3000 米，这是遇险呼叫。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Shanghai Control, CES 529, our cabin altitude is rising rapidly, request emergency descent to 3000 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，上海管制，CES 529，我们的客舱高度快速上升，请求紧急下降至 3000 米。

cards.audioText: C: CES 529, descend to 3000 meters on QNH 1031.
cards.referenceText: Descend to 3000 meters on QNH 1031, CES 529.

cards.audioText: B: Now you are maintaining 3000 meters, cabin altitude has resumed to normal, you will cancel Distress, report it to Shanghai Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你保持 3000 米，客舱高度已恢复正常，你将取消遇险，向上海进近报告。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Approach, CES 529, maintaining 3000 meters, the cabin altitude has resumed to normal, cancel Distress.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海进近，CES 529，保持 3000 米，客舱高度已恢复正常，取消遇险。

cards.audioText: B: The cabin crew reports 5 passengers in the cabin are seriously injured during emergency descent, inform the situation to Shanghai Control and request diversion to Hangzhou.
cards.audioTextZh: B：客舱机组报告 5 名旅客在紧急下降中严重受伤，向上海管制通报情况并请求备降杭州。
cards.referenceText: Shanghai Control, CES 529, 5 passengers are seriously injured, request divert to Hangzhou.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上海管制，CES 529，5 名旅客严重受伤，请求备降杭州。

cards.audioText:
C: CES 529, divert to Hangzhou approved, what assistance do you need?
B: Tell the controller you need ambulances upon arrival.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：CES 529，同意备降杭州，你需要什么协助？
B：告诉管制员抵达时需要救护车。
cards.referenceText: Divert to Hangzhou approved, request ambulances upon arrival, CES 529.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意备降杭州，请求抵达时救护车，CES 529。

cards.audioText: CES 529, roger, ambulance will be ready upon arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: CES 529，收到，救护车将在到达时就位。

cards.audioText: C: CES 529, turn right heading 180, descend and maintain 2100 meters, QNH 1031, expect ILS approach Runway 06.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 529，右转航向 180，下降并保持 2100 米，QNH 1031，预计 ILS 进近跑道 06。
cards.referenceText: Turn right heading 180, descend and maintain 2100 meters, QNH 1031, expect ILS approach Runway 06, CES 529.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向 180，下降并保持 2100 米，QNH 1031，预计 ILS 进近跑道 06，CES 529。

cards.audioText: B: Now tell Hangzhou Tower about your situation and request priority landing.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在告诉杭州塔台你的情况并请求优先着陆。
cards.referenceText: Hangzhou Tower, CES 529, 5 passengers were seriously injured during emergency descent, request priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 杭州塔台，CES 529，5 名旅客在紧急下降中严重受伤，请求优先着陆。

cards.audioText: C: CES 529, straight ILS approach Runway 06, report established.
cards.audioTextZh: C：CES 529，直线 ILS 进近跑道 06，报告建立。
cards.referenceText: Straight ILS approach Runway 06, report established, CES 529.
cards.referenceTextZh: 直线 ILS 进近跑道 06，报告建立，CES 529。

cards.audioText: B: Now you have established on ILS approach Runway 06.
cards.audioTextZh: B：现在你已建立 ILS 进近跑道 06。
cards.referenceText: Hangzhou Tower, CES 529, established on ILS approach Runway 06.
cards.referenceTextZh: 杭州塔台，CES 529，已建立 ILS 进近跑道 06。
